newsitem.title: USA: CME lumber futures end little higher.
newsitem.headline: CME lumber futures end little higher.

text.p: CME lumber futures continued to show little price direction and ended with small gains after trading on both sides of previous levels, traders said.
Lumber closed $0.70 per tbf higher to unchanged with July up most at $400.60 and September up $0.50 at $388.40 per tbf.

Futures continued to trade uneven awaiting fresh direction from cash markets and the latest word on interest rates. July moved over the $400 level but again ran into light commercial selling interest. Expectations interest rates would stay low provided the bulk of support, traders added.
